response.goal: Build an n8n workflow that triggers on new responses from two Typeform forms, checks the Google Sheet for an existing row with the same email to skip duplicates, adds a new row with name, email, company, form name and timestamp, posts a message to a Slack channel with a link to the row, and emails if any step fails.

plan.step: Kickoff and connection setup for Typeform, Google Sheets, Slack, and error handling
Build workflow triggers for both Typeform forms
Implement duplicate check logic by email against the Google Sheet
Configure row insertion and Slack alert message with row link
Set up error handler to email upon failure and perform end-to-end testing

milestones.name: Milestone 1: Core n8n Workflow & Triggers
milestones.deliverable: Connected Typeform triggers, duplicate check, and Google Sheet row addition.

milestones.name: Milestone 2: Slack Alerts, Error Handling & Testing
milestones.deliverable: Working Slack notification, error email alerts, and fully tested workflow.

risks.risk: Self-hosted n8n instance might have network or webhook exposure limitations.
risks.mitigation: Verify webhook accessibility and instance permissions during kickoff.

risks.risk: Typeform payload structures for the two forms might differ in field names.
risks.mitigation: Map out both form structures and normalize data fields before building the duplicate check.

questions: What email service or node would you prefer for the failure notification emails?
Do you already have administrative access prepared for adding webhooks in both Typeform forms?
assumptions: The client will provide access credentials to their self-hosted n8n instance, Typeform, Google Sheets, and Slack.
The budget is hourly between $25-$40 per hour as stated in the post.
